t: Cities Aren't Loud: Cars Are Loud

q.x: I don't get why I am getting such emotional responses. Most of the noise in cities comes from cars, that is a fact. Even dense cities can be fairly quiet. I suggest watching this video: [link]

desc:
Watch this video ad-free on Nebula: https://nebula.tv/videos/not-just-bikes-cities-aren-t-loud-cars-are-loud

Urban noise is a common problem, and the vast majority of it is created by motor vehicles. Noise is far too often dismissed as a minor nuisance, rather than the legitimate health issue that it is.
